features.description: Green Dragon (reels 2, 4) and Golden Dragon (reel 3) symbols turn entire reels wild when there's a payline win. Golden Dragon provides 8x multiplier.

features.name: Buy Bonus
features.description: Optional feature costing 25% of base stake that doubles the chance to trigger the Free Spins Bonus Round.

features.name: Respin
features.description: Golden Dragon may randomly appear after a non-winning base game to award 1 free game with reel 3 as a wild reel with 8x multiplier.

specs.description: Lucky 8™ Golden Dragon is an Asian-themed 20-payline slot featuring the legendary Golden Dragon. The game includes wild reels with 8x multipliers, free spins with locked wild reels, and a special Dragon Blessing feature that can award bonus games after non-winning spins.

functional_symbols.name: Green Dragon
functional_symbols.description: Wild symbol appearing on reels 2 and 4 that turns entire reel wild when there's a payline win

functional_symbols.name: Golden Dragon
functional_symbols.description: Wild symbol appearing on reel 3 that turns entire reel wild with 8x multiplier when there's a payline win

functional_symbols.name: Bonus
functional_symbols.description: Scatter symbol that triggers Free Spins Bonus Round when 3, 4, or 5 appear anywhere on reels

features.name: Free Spins
features.context: H2 section LOTS O' POTZ FREE SPINS
features.description: Triggered by landing POWER POT below a FREE SPINS tile on the Prize Carousel, awarding 10 free spins. During free spins, all wins trigger ULTRANUDGE and there are more POWER POTZ on reels.

features.name: Nudges
features.description: Any win that includes WILD triggers ULTRANUDGE, where all symbols nudge down one position and continue until no more wins occur. During free spins, any win starts ULTRANUDGE.
characteristics: All wins trigger in free spins

features.name: Cash On Reels
features.description: POWER POT symbols land on reels and collect prizes from the Prize Carousel above, which contains CASH tiles with values of x2 to x1000 total bet. POWER POTZ can land on reels 1, 3, 5 in base game.
characteristics: Prize Carousel moves position each spin
POWER POTZ on reels 1, 3, 5 in base game

features.name: Buy Bonus
features.description: Players can pay x100 to buy into Free Spins with their choice of bet size, awarding 10 Free Spins directly.

specs.description: POWER POTZ UltraNudge features the ULTRANUDGE mechanic where wins with wilds cause symbols to nudge down for streak wins. The Prize Carousel above reels moves each spin with cash prizes and free spins that are collected by POWER POT symbols landing on the reels. Free spins enhance the features with more POWER POTZ and all wins triggering ULTRANUDGE.

functional_symbols.name: WILD
functional_symbols.description: Substitutes for other symbols and triggers ULTRANUDGE when part of a win

functional_symbols.name: POWER POT
functional_symbols.description: Collects prizes from the Prize Carousel above the reels when landing

features.name: Free Spins
features.context: H2 section dedicated to Wolf Spirits Free Spins Bonus
features.description: Triggered by 3 or more Bonus Scatter symbols, awards 8 free spins with enhanced Arctic Circles feature providing multipliers up to 12x. Can be retriggered for up to 300 total free spins.

features.name: Respin
features.context: H2 section dedicated to Animals Locked Respins Feature
features.description: Triggered by 3 or more matching adjacent animal symbols (Lynx, Deer, Owl, Rabbit) that are not part of a win. Locks triggering reels and respins remaining reels, with additional respins if triggering symbols appear.

features.name: Symbol Transformation
features.context: H2 section for Arctic Circles Feature
features.description: Arctic Circles reveal symbols or multipliers on each spin. When revealed symbols match symbols adjacent to wilds on the reels, those matching symbols transform into wild symbols.

specs.description: Polar Wilds is a medium volatility 5-reel video slot featuring the Arctic Circles feature that transforms symbols into wilds and provides multipliers up to 12x. The Animals Locked Respins feature offers extra chances for big wins with animal symbols.

functional_symbols.name: Wild
functional_symbols.description: Appears on reels 2, 3, and 4 in base game and all reels in free spins. Substitutes for other symbols and enables Arctic Circles transformations.

functional_symbols.name: Bonus Scatter
functional_symbols.description: Triggers Wolf Spirits Free Spins Bonus when 3 or more appear anywhere. Also retriggers bonus when appearing on reel 4 during free spins.

functional_symbols.name: Animal Symbols
functional_symbols.description: Lynx, Deer, Owl, and Rabbit symbols that can trigger the Animals Locked Respins feature when 3 or more matching symbols appear adjacent.

features.name: Expanding Reels
features.description: Game starts with 3 reels and adds new reels infinitely to the right when the rightmost reel improves any symbol combination. Each new reel increases the multiplier.
characteristics: multiplier increases with each new reel

features.name: Free Spins
features.description: Triggered by CHEST symbols through the Wheel Feature. Awards variable number of spins with enhanced multiplier increments during Infinity Reels expansion.

features.name: Wheel
features.description: Five progressive wheels triggered by CHEST symbols. Can award cash prizes, increase free spins, or improve multiplier increments before starting Free Spins.

features.name: Static Jackpot
features.description: Fixed jackpot structure including Infinity Bonus (888x total bet for 13+ reels) and tiered Bonus Prizes (Mini: 10x, Minor: 25x, Major: 100x, Grand: 1000x total bet).

specs.description: An innovative slot featuring Infinity Reels mechanics that starts with 3 reels and expands infinitely to the right. Each new reel increases win multipliers, with the ultimate goal of reaching 13 reels for the 888x Infinity Bonus. CHEST symbols trigger a multi-wheel feature leading to enhanced Free Spins.

functional_symbols.name: WILD
functional_symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except CHEST, appears on reel 2 and onwards

functional_symbols.name: CHEST
functional_symbols.description: Scatter symbol that triggers Wheel Feature in base game and awards extra spins in Free Spins

features.name: Free Spins
features.context: H3 section 'Free Spins' - triggered by 3 Free Spin symbols
features.description: 3 Free Spin symbols trigger a Free Spin Wheel that awards free spins with a multiplier. All line wins during free spins are multiplied by the wheel multiplier.

features.name: Wheel
features.context: Free Spins section describing wheel that awards spins and multiplier
features.description: A bonus wheel that spins once when 3 Free Spin symbols appear, awarding both the number of free spins and a multiplier value.

specs.description: 9 Races to Glory is a 5-reel, 3-row sports-themed video slot with 20 fixed paylines. The game features Free Spins triggered by a wheel that awards both free spins and multipliers, creating exciting win potential for horse racing enthusiasts.

functional_symbols.name: Wild
functional_symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Jockey Scatter and Free Spin symbols

functional_symbols.name: Jockey Scatter
functional_symbols.description: Scatter symbol that pays when 3 or more appear anywhere on screen

functional_symbols.name: Free Spin
functional_symbols.description: Scatter symbol appearing on reels 2, 3, and 4 only that triggers the Free Spin Wheel when 3 land

features.name: Free Spins
features.description: Landing 3 Power Chili scatter symbols triggers Power Chili Spins, awarding 7 initial free spins. Additional spins can be retriggered up to 15 total.

features.name: Colossal Symbols
features.description: Gran Chico creates 2x2 Mega Wild symbols in base game and 2x3 Mega Wild in Ultimate Hot Spin.

features.name: Persistence
features.description: Every time the Hot Amigo lands on reels, the Chili Meter progresses, carrying state across free spins to unlock features and retriggers.
characteristics: meter progresses with Hot Amigo symbols

specs.description: Luchamigos is a 5-reel Mexican wrestling-themed slot with up to 1024 ways to win. Features Hot Amigo random features including Mega Wilds, Stacked Wilds, and Random Wilds, plus Power Chili Spins with progressive Chili Meter and Ultimate Hot Spin finale.

functional_symbols.name: Amigo Wild
functional_symbols.description: Substitutes for all symbols except Power Chili scatter, triggers Hot Amigo features when combined with scatter

functional_symbols.name: Power Chili
functional_symbols.description: Scatter symbol appearing on reels 1, 3, and 5 only, triggers Power Chili Spins when 3 land
